savings.reason: Final savings classification is withheld with the unresolved first-cessation/earlier-amendment gaps. The original and EO13138 have been read; neither shows an express savings clause preserving an independent committee command. See the research rationale for the material missing evidence.

research_rationale: EO12961 section 4(b) makes committee termination turn on actual submission of its final report plus 30 days. Section 2(f) gives a December 31, 1996 reporting deadline, which cannot prove actual submission or fix the termination date. EO13138 section 3(g), effective September 30, 1999 under section 9, formally revokes the amended order and describes the committee as already terminated with its work completed. The dossier expressly lacks EO13033 and EO13034 provisions, and contains no actual final-report submission evidence. The inherited NO status remains unchanged, but the earliest effective cessation cannot be established from this one-file evidence.
unresolved_material_gaps: Actual final-report submission date (and any relevant report/termination amendment in EO13034) is absent; the reporting deadline cannot substitute for the trigger.
The dossier expressly lacks target provisions of EO13033 and EO13034; their effects on earlier clause history remain unread.
